# providers.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown providers.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/providers.toml, else ~/.config/letibot/providers.toml

API keys, provider doors, per-model sampling and fleet models, prices, and box-wide limits

Written by: the daemon, from /models --key, /default-model and the first-turn key prompt: it rewrites only [default] or [NAME], mode 0600

## `[default]`

Below both leticode.toml levels.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | local | preset a daemon starts on without --provider; "local" = the local server |
| `model` | string | the preset's default | model for that preset |

## `[fallback]`

A leticode.toml fallback wins over this one.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `models` | list of models | [] (the turn fails) | models to move to when the session's model is out, in order |

## `[<preset>]`

One per built-in preset, by canonical name (deepseek, glm, glm-coding, grok, anthropic, openai, gemini, kimi-code, ...). The preset's env variable wins.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | env variable, then opencode's auth.json | API key |
| `url` | URL | the preset's | endpoint the client posts to |

## `[provider.<name>]`

A new door, or a change to a built-in or env door (env-anthropic, env-openai). Unknown keys are refused.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocol` | chat-completions \| anthropic-messages \| responses \| genai | required for a new door | wire protocol |
| `url` | http(s) URL | required for a new door | endpoint |
| `model` | string | required for a new door | default model sent |
| `key_env` | env variable | <NAME>_API_KEY | variable holding the key |
| `key` | string | none | API key |
| `catalogue` | string | "" | models.dev provider id |
| `thinking` | string | none | body field that turns thinking on |
| `fixed` | list of sampling keys | [] | keys the endpoint refuses; dropped before sending |
| `aliases` | list | [] | other names for a new door |
| `window` | int > 0 | catalogue's | context window when no catalogue has it |
| `usage` | /path \| URL \| "" | none | the plan's usage endpoint |

## `[model.<name>]`

Sampling for a model id, `preset/model`, local alias or dialect family (glm, qwen). With `url` it is a fleet model. Unknown keys are reported.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `temperature` | float | built-in | sampler |
| `top_p` | float | built-in | sampler |
| `top_k` | int | built-in | sampler; local only |
| `min_p` | float | built-in | sampler; local only |
| `presence_penalty` | float | built-in | sampler |
| `frequency_penalty` | float | built-in | sampler |
| `repeat_penalty` | float | built-in | sampler; local only |
| `seed` | int | none | sampler |
| `max_tokens` | int | none | reply cap |
| `thinking_budget_tokens` | int | none | thinking cap; local only |
| `effort` | string | built-in | dialect reasoning effort; local and fleet only |
| `url` | URL | none | makes this a fleet model at that address |
| `endpoint` | URL | none | same as url |
| `model` | string | the table name | model name sent to the fleet server |
| `window` | int > 0 | measured | context window of a fleet model |
| `context_window` | int > 0 | measured | same as window |
| `dialect` | glm \| qwen | from the chat template | dialect of a fleet model |

## `[prices.<model>]`

MODEL is the billed model id. All three keys are required; a bad one fails the whole file.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | float | required | USD per million uncached input tokens |
| `cached` | float | required | USD per million cached input tokens |
| `output` | float | required | USD per million output tokens |

## `[gatekeeper]`

The guard. leticode.toml gatekeeper_model overrides `model`.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | HOST:PORT | none: no guard | guard model's address |
| `oracle` | HOST:PORT | none | old name of endpoint |
| `model` | string | none | guard model name |
| `budget_ms` | int | 400 | time budget per guard answer |
| `intents` | words | built-in | intents the guard may answer |
| `max_scope` | in_run \| host_project \| host_other \| external | host_project | furthest reach the guard may answer for |
| `scope` | as max_scope | host_project | old name of max_scope |
| `tools` | words | none | tools the guard may answer about |

## `[memory]`

Amounts: a size (64M, 2G) or a fraction (0.5, 50%). leticode.toml [memory] overrides default and ceiling.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | amount | 64M | cap for a tool call that names none |
| `ceiling` | amount | 0.5 of free | most a call may take without asking |
| `daemon_high` | amount \| max | 16G | memory.high on the daemon's cgroup |
| `gate` | amount \| uncapped | half of free at gate start | cap per merge-gate step |
| `owner_high` | amount \| max | none | memory.high on each owner's cgroup |
| `slice_high` | amount \| max | 60% of RAM | MemoryHigh on letibot.slice |

## `[metrics]`

A bad value is the default.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | true | the metrics event table is on |
| `keep_days` | int > 0 | 90 | raw rows older than this are rolled up |
| `snippets` | event kinds | context.claim | kinds that keep their snippet |
| `rate_per_sec` | int; 0 = no cap | 20 | identical events one key may write per second |
| `max_mb` | int; 0 = no ceiling | 2048 | metrics.db size ceiling in MiB |

## `[brave]`

Read by web_search. $BRAVE_API_KEY and $BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY win.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | none | Brave Search API key |
